types.name: swap.v1.CreateSwapRequest
types.doc: CreateSwapRequest creates and executes a Swap.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Client-chosen key, unique per caller, that makes creation idempotent: the
 same key and request return the same Swap; another request with the same
 key is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Terms to execute.

fields.name: min_amount_out_e18
fields.doc:
Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the whole amount, in
 18-decimal units, usually the quote's min_amount_out_e18. Execution never
 nets a lower rate; what cannot be traded at it stays on the account.

fields.name: quote_expires_at
fields.doc:
The accepted quote's expires_at. The Swap is refused with QUOTE_EXPIRED
 once it has passed.

types.name: swap.v1.CreateSwapResponse
types.doc: CreateSwapResponse is the created (or existing) Swap.

fields.name: swap
fields.doc: The Swap.

types.name: swap.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc: ErrorCode identifies a Swap API error.

values.name: ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc:
No spot market trades the source asset directly against the destination
 asset.

values.name: AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE
values.doc:
The amount is outside the market's current limits. The error carries the
 limits (min_amount_e18, max_amount_e18) when known.

values.name: QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: No price is currently available for the route; retry later.

values.name: PROTECTION_UNACHIEVABLE
values.doc:
Current order-book depth cannot deliver min_amount_out_e18 (or the
 requested slippage): request a new quote.

values.name: QUOTE_EXPIRED
values.doc: quote_expires_at has passed: request a new quote.

values.name: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
values.doc:
The idempotency key was already used with a different request. The error
 carries the original swap_id.

values.name: SWAP_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No Swap of the caller matches the selector.

values.name: INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_ID
values.doc: subaccount_id is not a valid sub-account ID.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The sub-account does not exist.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT_INACTIVE
values.doc: The sub-account is not active.

values.name: SWAP_NOT_PERMITTED
values.doc:
The caller may not Swap on the account: the role, the API key's policy or
 the sub-account's policy does not grant SWAP, or a root-scoped API key
 selected a sub-account.

values.name: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A required service is temporarily unavailable; retry the same request.

values.name: DIRECTION_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc:
The market trades the two assets but cannot execute a Swap in this
 direction: a buy there would pay its fee in the asset it spends.

types.name: swap.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to Swap errors as an error detail of type
 swap.v1.ErrorDetail.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT only: the Swap bound to the idempotency key.

fields.name: min_amount_e18
fields.doc:
AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE only: the smallest amount that currently quotes, in
 18-decimal units of the source asset. Guidance, not a guarantee.

fields.name: max_amount_e18
fields.doc:
AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE only: the largest amount current depth absorbs, in
 18-decimal units of the source asset.

types.name: swap.v1.GetSwapRequest
types.doc: GetSwapRequest selects one Swap of the caller.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Swap ID.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: Idempotency key the Swap was created with.

fields.name: swap
fields.doc: The Swap.

types.name: swap.v1.QuoteSwapRequest
types.doc: QuoteSwapRequest asks for a quote of terms.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Terms to quote.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc:
Accepted shortfall from the expected output, in basis points (1 bp =
 0.01%), from 1 to 1000; sets the quote's min_amount_out.

fields.name: quote
fields.doc: The quote.

types.name: swap.v1.Side
types.doc: Side is a spot order side.

values.name: BUY
values.doc: Buy the market's base asset with its quote asset.

values.name: SELL
values.doc: Sell the market's base asset for its quote asset.

types.name: swap.v1.Swap
types.doc:
Swap is one signed-in Swap and its outcome. Amounts count settled fills
 only.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Swap ID.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: Idempotency key the Swap was created with.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Sub-account public ID funding the Swap; 0 for the root account.

fields.name: source_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset spent.

fields.name: destination_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset received.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc: Source amount requested, in 18-decimal units.

fields.name: min_amount_out_e18
fields.doc:
Minimum destination amount after fees for the whole amount, in 18-decimal
 units. Each traded part nets at least this rate.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current status.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Why the Swap did not trade its whole amount; set with PARTIALLY_COMPLETED
 and FAILED.

fields.name: is_terminal
fields.doc: True once the status is final: COMPLETED, PARTIALLY_COMPLETED or FAILED.

fields.name: executed_amount_e18
fields.doc: Source amount spent in settled fills, in 18-decimal units.

fields.name: unspent_amount_e18
fields.doc:
Source amount not spent, in 18-decimal units; it never left the
 account. Final once is_terminal is true.

fields.name: received_amount_e18
fields.doc: Destination amount received after fees, in 18-decimal units.

fields.name: fee_e18
fields.doc: Total fee charged, in 18-decimal units of the destination asset.

fields.name: orders
fields.doc: The Swap's spot orders, in placement order.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the Swap was created.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapOrder
types.doc:
SwapOrder is one spot order of a Swap: an immediate-or-cancel limit order
 at the Swap's protection price.

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Spot order ID, once the market accepted the order; 0 before.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair ID from GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Side of the order.

fields.name: leg
fields.doc: Zero-based position of the order's market in the Swap's route.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: State of the order.

fields.name: limit_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Limit price in quote-asset price ticks (1e-9 quote units per base unit):
 the worst price at which the order nets the Swap's minimum rate after fees.

fields.name: spent_e18
fields.doc:
Amount the order spent in settled fills, fees in the spent asset included,
 in 18-decimal units.

fields.name: received_e18
fields.doc:
Amount the order received in settled fills after fees, in 18-decimal
 units.

fields.name: fee_e18
fields.doc:
Fee charged on settled fills, in 18-decimal units of the asset the order
 receives.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapOrderStatus
types.doc: SwapOrderStatus is the state of a Swap's spot order.

values.name: PLACING
values.doc: The order is being placed.

values.name: PLACED
values.doc: The order was accepted by the market.

values.name: REFUSED
values.doc: The order was refused before it reached the market.

values.name: NOT_PLACED
values.doc: The order was not placed before the execution window ended.

values.name: UNCONFIRMED
values.doc: The order's outcome is being established.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapQuote
types.doc:
SwapQuote is an estimate from current order-book depth. Nothing is
 reserved: the prices are indicative, and only min_amount_out binds once the
 Swap is created.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: The quoted terms.

fields.name: legs
fields.doc: Markets the Swap would trade on, in order. A direct Swap has one.

fields.name: expected_amount_out_e18
fields.doc: Estimated destination amount after fees, in 18-decimal units.

fields.name: min_amount_out_e18
fields.doc:
Minimum destination amount after fees at the requested slippage, in
 18-decimal units. Create the Swap with this value (or another accepted
 minimum) as min_amount_out_e18: whatever is executed then nets at least the
 same rate, and what cannot be stays on the account.

fields.name: quoted_at
fields.doc: When the quote was priced.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
Last moment the quote may be accepted, 30 seconds after quoted_at. Pass it
 as quote_expires_at when creating the Swap.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapQuoteLeg
types.doc: SwapQuoteLeg is one spot market a quote trades on.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair ID from GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Side of the order on the market.

fields.name: average_price
fields.doc:
Estimated average fill price, quote asset per base asset, as a decimal
 string; for display.

fields.name: price_impact_bps
fields.doc:
Distance of average_price from the best price of the book, in basis points,
 rounded up: the cost of the order's size against current depth.

fields.name: taker_fee_rate_percent
fields.doc:
The account's spot taker fee rate on the market, in percent (for example
 "0.1" for 0.1%), as a decimal string.

fields.name: fee_e18
fields.doc:
Estimated fee, in 18-decimal units of the asset the leg receives
 (fee_asset_id).

fields.name: fee_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset the fee is charged in: the asset the leg receives.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapReason
types.doc: SwapReason says why a Swap did not trade its whole amount.

values.name: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE
values.doc: The Trading balance did not cover the amount when the order was placed.

values.name: PRICE_PROTECTION
values.doc:
The order books could not fill the rest at a price that meets
 min_amount_out.

values.name: MARKET_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: The market was closed, halted, restricted or without liquidity.

values.name: ORDER_SIZE_OUT_OF_RANGE
values.doc: The order was outside the market's size limits.

values.name: RATE_LIMITED
values.doc: The account's order rate limit was reached.

values.name: ORDER_REJECTED
values.doc: The order was refused, for example by the sub-account's trading policy.

values.name: EXPIRED
values.doc: The execution window ended before the order could be placed.

values.name: MINIMUM_NOT_MET
values.doc:
A fill netted less than the accepted minimum rate. The Swap failed closed:
 the amounts show exactly what was traded and received.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapStatus
types.doc: SwapStatus is the state of a Swap.

values.name: EXECUTING
values.doc: The Swap is accepted and its orders are being placed, filled or settled.

values.name: COMPLETED
values.doc:
The whole amount was traded and settled (a remainder smaller than one
 order step stays on the account, unspent).

values.name: PARTIALLY_COMPLETED
values.doc:
Part of the amount was traded and settled; the rest stays on the account,
 unspent. reason says why.

values.name: FAILED
RECONCILING
values.doc:
An order's outcome is being established. Balances already reflect any
 settled fill; the Swap stays here until the outcome is confirmed.

types.name: swap.v1.SwapTerms
types.doc:
SwapTerms are the economic terms of one Swap: spend amount_e18 of the
 source asset from the account's Trading balance and receive the destination
 asset there. The same terms are quoted and created. A Swap executes as spot
 orders at the account's own spot taker fee; no other fee is charged.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account public ID whose Trading balance funds the Swap. When
 omitted, the caller's root account funds it, or the sub-account an API key
 is bound to.

fields.name: source_asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset spent: a unified asset ID, as used for balances and internal
 transfers.

fields.name: destination_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset received: a unified asset ID.

fields.name: amount_e18
